Ivy (AE): quick handoff for Windward — signed last week. main asks: SSO + small private eval (single node) before they commit to Dedicated. renewal window in 10 months, but CFO wants usage forecast. handing to CS for activation + eng/support for private eval.
Nico (CSM): thanks Ivy. Can you drop the initial contact list + SSO IdP metadata?
Ivy (AE): added files to the sales drive: https://drive.redwood/windward/handoff (metadata + contract summary). primary contact = sara@windward.co, tech = tom@windward.co.
Nico (CSM): got it. I'll kick off onboarding. ETA for basic activation?
Ravi (Support): low-level infra Qs: will the private eval need VPN or can we do VPC peering? also want to know expected qps during eval.
Diane (Infra Eng): tagging infra — for single-node private eval we need a window to provision and validate network. prefer a 2hr slot. we also need customer's IP allowlist + KMS details if they want encrypted keys.
Ivy (AE): customer prefers VPC peering, expecting ~15 rps bursty. they can provide IPs and KMS arns.
Nico (CSM): plan: 1) basic hosted onboarding (credentials, quickstart) 2) schedule private eval provisioning 3) capture usage baseline for finance. I'll own coordination.
Ravi (Support): please open an infra ticket with logs/attach sample payloads. tag me and Diane.
Nico (CSM): creating ticket now: CS-789 (Onboarding: Windward hosted->private eval). linking checklist below.
Oncall Bot: deploy-bot scheduled a provision job for cs-private-queue on 1745020000 (ETA ~2hrs).
Nico (CSM): checklist (short):
- [Ivy] confirm contact + IdP metadata (done)
- [Nico] create CS-789 + onboarding runbook (in progress)
- [Diane] provision single-node private eval + networking (pending)
- [Ravi] review logs & support the validation tests (pending)
- [Nico] capture 72h usage baseline and share with finance (owner: Nico)
Ivy (AE): note: customer flagged potential renewal risk if latency >200ms for their model. be conservative on SLOs for eval.
Diane (Infra Eng): understoond. we'll run the perf smoke with artifacts: `ab -n 1000 -c 20 http://private-endpoint/gen` and capture p95/p99.
Ravi (Support): I'll prepare a validation checklist (auth, KV cache warmup, sample prompts). will attach to CS-789.
Nico (CSM): thanks all. Next steps: I'll confirm a 2hr provisioning window with Tom and update CS-789 with times. pinging @Diane and @Ravi for blocking items. :thumbsup:
Ivy (AE): thanks — I'll intro Tom on the ticket and add Sara to the finance sync.
